## Problem 1




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
beta0 <- -1
beta1 <- 1
n <- 100
x <- rnorm(n)
p <- plogis(beta0 + beta1*x)
y <- rbinom(n=n, size=1, prob=p)
data1 <- data.frame(y=y, x=x)
```
:::




## Problem 2



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fm2 <- glm(y ~ x, family=binomial, data=data1)
summary(fm2)
```

## Problem 3


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
cawa.data <- read.csv("cawa_data_glm.csv", row.names=1)
cawa.data$year <- factor(cawa.data$year)
fm3.1 <- glm(abundance ~ elevation, family=poisson, data=cawa.data)
fm3.2 <- glm(abundance ~ year, family=poisson, data=cawa.data)
fm3.3 <- glm(abundance ~ elevation*year, family=poisson, data=cawa.data)
fm3.4 <- glm(abundance ~ (elevation+I(elevation^2))*year, family=poisson,
             data=cawa.data)
AIC(fm3.1, fm3.2, fm3.3, fm3.4)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
      df      AIC
fm3.1  2 2924.612
fm3.2  7 3170.598
fm3.3 14 2869.096
fm3.4 21 2416.499
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
elev.seq <- seq(min(cawa.data$elev), max(cawa.data$elev), length=20)
n.years <- nlevels(cawa.data$year)
year.seq <- levels(cawa.data$year)
pred.data3 <- data.frame(elevation=rep(elev.seq, times=n.years),
                         year=rep(year.seq, each=length(elev.seq)))
pred <- predict(fm3.4, newdata=pred.data3, type="response", se=TRUE)
pred.data3$fit <- pred$fit
plot(abundance ~ elevation, data=cawa.data)
lines(fit ~ elevation, data=pred.data3, subset=year=="2014", col=1)
lines(fit ~ elevation, data=pred.data3, subset=year=="2015", col=2)
lines(fit ~ elevation, data=pred.data3, subset=year=="2016", col=3)
lines(fit ~ elevation, data=pred.data3, subset=year=="2017", col=4)
lines(fit ~ elevation, data=pred.data3, subset=year=="2018", col=5)
lines(fit ~ elevation, data=pred.data3, subset=year=="2019", col=6)
lines(fit ~ elevation, data=pred.data3, subset=year=="2020", col=7)
legend(900, 15, as.character(2014:2020), lty=1, col=1:7)
```
